name: Dog House | Mega
description:
RS 11 x Sherb Cream Pie | Sweet, Fruit

Mega is a powerhouse cross of RS 11 and Sherb Cream Pie, bred by BeanFiendsz to deliver a flavor profile that lives up to its name. Bursting with creamy sherbet notes and hints of ripe berries, its aroma fills the room with a blend of sugary citrus and soft vanilla. The buds are dense and vibrant, showcasing deep purples swirled with bright orange hairs, all wrapped in a frosty layer of trichomes.
